checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: The clip is reported as 10 s and frames were sampled up to 9.5 s.

must.item: One continuous excerpt from jet-30s.mp4 with source framing and speed preserved
must.why: The AI re-rendered the clip at 832x512 (about 1.625:1) instead of the source 16:9. The frames show a re-generated look, and the cuts between shots look different from the source.

must.item: Excerpt contains a salient moment of jet action or cockpit interaction
must.why: It shows jets flying in formation, a pilot in the cockpit and a wingman jet, with cockpit dialogue.

must.item: Original sound stays synchronized; no added music, narration or captions
must.why: The audio cannot be heard. The picture is a regenerated render, so sync is not guaranteed. Burned-in subtitles appear in the frames, and they may be original or may have been regenerated.

faults.what: The clip is an AI re-render and not a true trim. Aspect ratio and resolution changed (832x512), and the detail is soft and AI-looking.
The subtitle 'Right here, Vega.' reads as 'Right here, Vəga.', which is garbled text from regeneration.
The jets and pilot faces are re-generated. They may differ from the source, and the frames show visible AI softness.

summary: The output is a 10 s AI re-render of the middle section, not a faithful cut: the aspect ratio changed, it is soft and regenerated, and one subtitle is garbled, although the content is action-rich.
